scope: Historical frozen regular N58 local state only. This is a research handoff / alternative combinatorial derivation of J<=609. It does not alter selector, runtime, proof resources, or P-vs-NP status.

frozen_state.regularity: L=n*d=350, hence all seven live variables have incidence degree exactly 50

theorem_statement: In the frozen regular state above, the number J of NEW distinct non-tautological resolvents not already in the retained raw set satisfies J<=609.

proof.name: Assume dangerous regime
proof.statement: Assume for contradiction J>=610. Choose exactly one generating parent-pair edge for each of 610 distinct new non-tautological resolvent outputs. The chosen 610 edges therefore have pairwise distinct outputs.

proof.name: Extract a complete injective rectangle
proof.statement: The full P x Q grid has 22*28=616 edges, so at most six edges are not among the chosen representatives. Delete from Q every Q-vertex incident to any unchosen edge. At most six Q-vertices are deleted, hence at least 22 Q-vertices remain. For every surviving q and every p in P, edge (p,q) is chosen; therefore all edges of P x Q_survive are non-tautological and have pairwise distinct outputs. Restrict to any 22 surviving Q-vertices. We obtain a complete cross-compatible injective rectangle P0 x Q0 with |P0|=|Q0|=22 and 484 pairwise distinct signed-union outputs.

proof.name: Classify each signed coordinate
proof.statement: For one nonpivot coordinate y, let S_P(y),S_Q(y) be the values used by P0,Q0 in {OMIT,POS,NEG}. Complete cross-compatibility forbids POS on one side together with NEG on the other. If one side uses both POS and NEG, the other side must be constantly OMIT; call y a private ternary coordinate of the first side. Every remaining coordinate uses at most one common nonzero sign plus OMIT, hence is at most a shared binary-OR coordinate. Let e_P,e_Q be the numbers of private ternary coordinates and s=6-e_P-e_Q the remaining binary coordinates.

proof.name: Output alphabet forces at least five ternary coordinates
proof.statement: The injective rectangle has 484 outputs. The coordinatewise output alphabet has at most 3^(e_P+e_Q)*2^s values. If e_P+e_Q<=4, this is at most 3^4*2^2=324<484. Hence e_P+e_Q>=5.

proof.name: Five ternary coordinates cannot hold 22 codewords on each side
proof.statement: If e_P+e_Q=5 then s=1. P0 can vary only on its e_P private ternary coordinates and on the one binary coordinate, so |P0|<=3^e_P*2. Since |P0|=22, e_P>=3. Symmetrically |Q0|=22 implies e_Q>=3, contradicting e_P+e_Q=5. Therefore e_P+e_Q=6 and s=0.

proof.name: The six coordinates split exactly 3+3
proof.statement: With s=0, |P0|<=3^e_P and |Q0|<=3^e_Q. Both sizes are 22, so e_P>=3 and e_Q>=3. Since e_P+e_Q=6, necessarily e_P=e_Q=3. Thus three coordinates are P-private and three are Q-private.

proof.name: Minimum omissions within three ternary coordinates
proof.statement: Any 22 distinct words of {OMIT,POS,NEG}^3 contain at least 16 OMIT symbols in total. Proof: there are 8 words with zero OMITs, 12 words with exactly one OMIT, 6 with exactly two, and 1 with three. The 22 words with minimum possible total omissions consist of all 8 zero-OMIT words, all 12 one-OMIT words, and 2 two-OMIT words, giving 0*8+1*12+2*2=16.

proof.name: Selected P parents already contribute at least 82 omissions
proof.statement: Every P0 parent omits all three Q-private coordinates, contributing 22*3=66 omissions. On the three P-private coordinates the 22 P0 tails must be distinct (otherwise two P parents paired with the same Q0 parent would have the same output), so Step 7 contributes at least 16 more omissions. Therefore P0 contributes at least 82 omissions across the six nonpivot coordinates.

proof.name: Selected Q parents also contribute at least 82 omissions
proof.statement: By symmetry Q0 contributes at least 22*3+16=82 omissions. Hence these 44 selected pivot-parent clauses alone contribute at least 164 omissions.

proof.name: Regular-incidence omission identity contradicts 164
proof.statement: Because every live variable has degree d=50, for a nonpivot variable y occurring t_y times in the c=27 retained clauses, y occurs exactly 50-t_y times among the 50 pivot-parent clauses and is therefore omitted from exactly t_y pivot parents. Summing over the six nonpivot variables, the TOTAL number of pivot-parent omissions equals T=sum_y t_y, the retained literal mass. But T<=c*r=27*6=162. Steps 8-9 exhibit 164 omissions inside only 44 of the 50 pivot parents, contradiction.

conclusion.relation_to_existing_algorithmist_proof: Independent shorter route discovered while translating N58 into two-codebook/zero-error-channel language; it agrees with the existing J<=609 regular-incidence occupancy result and does not supersede its verified artifact.

generalizable_lemmas.near_injective_to_rectangle: For a p-by-q pair grid with J pairwise distinct represented outputs, selecting one edge per output leaves at most e=p*q-J unselected edges. Deleting all Q endpoints incident to unselected edges leaves a fully represented injective rectangle of size at least p*(q-e), whenever q>e. Symmetrically one may retain at least (p-e)*q by deleting P endpoints.
generalizable_lemmas.signed_cross_compatible_coordinate_decom: Any complete cross-compatible pair of signed ternary codebooks over r coordinates decomposes coordinates into P-private ternary, Q-private ternary, and remaining at-most-binary shared coordinates.
generalizable_lemmas.minimum_omission_mass: For k distinct ternary words of length t, the minimum total OMIT count is obtained by taking words in increasing order of number of OMIT coordinates; layer z contains C(t,z)*2^(t-z) words. For t=3,k=22 the exact minimum is 16.
